thread:
joanne: quick heads-up: i'm trying to land a tiny PR that adds a 'minimum viable' onboarding checklist for Dedicated capacity (provisioning + autoscale + tenant isolation). aim: super short, link-forward, and backportable. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/497

ryan: send the branch? i'll eyeball the terraform + yaml examples. also will check for deprecated provider blocks.

joanne: branch docs/dedicated/minvi-onboard. files: ded/onboard.md, snippets/terraform-dedicated.hcl, examples/autoscale.yml, sdk/snippets/python-reserve.md.

ryan: got it. quick notes after a run: terraform uses `aws` provider without `region` set; add `provider \"aws\" { region = var.region }`. autoscale yaml missing `cooldown_seconds` and `min_replicas`. added comments in PR.

joanne: perfect, please push fixes to branch.

tina: legal-bot ping: SLA wording flag. we can't imply platform SLA unless customer purchased Dedicated. propose: \"Redwood offers configurable latency targets; contractual SLAs available for Dedicated subscriptions.\" safe?

legal-bot: recommended phrasing logged: \"Redwood offers configurable latency SLOs; contractual SLAs are available for Dedicated subscriptions.\"

joanne: i'll adopt the legal phrasing. thanks.

ryan: small SDK thing: python snippet uses `reserve()` keyword args but the current lib uses `create_reservation(...)`. also catch `ReservedCapacityError` in example. suggested snippet: ```python
from redwood.dedicated import Client, ReservedCapacityError
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
try:
    res = client.create_reservation(token='rsv-xyz', region='us-west-2')
    print(res.id)
except ReservedCapacityError as e:
    print('reservation failed:', e)
```

joanne: good catch. will update.

ryan: link-bot: i left two anchor warnings. One is `#autoscale-policy` which collides with capacity handbook. Recommend renaming to `#dedicated-autoscale-policy` and adding redirect. second is a stray broken link to `docs/kms` (internal path moved).

link-bot: queued link-check for PR 497. run id lc-2026-05-03-12.

joanne: i'll rename anchor and add redirect entry in docs/config/redirects.yaml: `- from: /docs/capacity#autoscale-policy
  to: /docs/dedicated#dedicated-autoscale-policy`

ryan: also suggest a 1-line example for isolation decorators in the onboard doc. something like: \"Example: `isolation: tenant` to allocate per-tenant nodes; see runtime isolation guide for caveats.\" keeps it light.

joanne: adding that. also replacing any detailed KMS commands with: \"refer to KMS integration guide; rotate keys per org policy.\"

link-bot: link-check complete: 2 warnings (anchors), 0 errors. please apply redirect change.

joanne: applied redirect and pushed. final checklist for merge: - ryan approves snippet updates - legal-bot confirms SLA phrase - link-bot clean.

ryan: i approve the code snippets. small formatting nit on terraform comments but not blocking.

legal-bot: SLA phrasing approved.

joanne: merging in 5m unless any objections. will backport to handbook branch after merge. thanks y'all :ship:
